pl-l4d24c2-d1e112.summary: States that there are seven because of the sevenfold grace of the Holy Spirit; those who do not share in it approach the Church's grades unworthily, while those in whose minds that grace is poured out are believed to receive greater grace in being promoted to a spiritual grade.
claims: The seven orders answer to the sevenfold grace of the Spirit.

pl-l4d24c2.summary: There are seven orders because of the sevenfold grace of the Spirit: those who lack it approach the orders unworthily, while those in whom it is poured out are believed to receive more grace in being promoted.
claims: The seven orders correspond to the sevenfold grace of the Spirit.
Those without that grace approach orders unworthily.
